Settings.hero_limit_hint: The tier at which a Hero is overcome. A status one tier higher is permanent, usually meaning death or transformation. The Core Book default is 5; lower values make Heroes easier to overcome. Values above 5 are homebrew and extend every status track to one tier above the Hero Limit.
Settings.improve_threshold_hint: Improve marks needed to choose a theme advancement. The Core Book default is 3; raise it to slow advancement.
Settings.persistent_token_labels_hint: Show visible tokens' tags and statuses without hovering.
Settings.player_initiated_rolls_hint: Allow players to start rolls without a Narrator's Call. When disabled, the Roll button sends a request to the Narrator. Players can still join rolls, contribute tags, react, Sacrifice, and take camp actions.
Settings.popout_tags_sidebar_hint: Automatically open the Tags sidebar in a pop-out window on load.
Settings.require_roll_approval_hint: Player rolls require approval through a chat card before the dice are rolled. Approved rolls execute on the player's client. This setting does not affect who can start a roll and does not apply to Narrator or group rolls.
Settings.show_camping_threats_hint: Show the Threats section during camps and sojourns. Disable it if your table tracks threats with Challenges or journals instead.
Settings.theme_limit_hint: Maximum number of themes a Hero can have. The Core Book default is 4.
Settings.token_tooltip_statuses_only_hint: Show only statuses in token labels and tooltips. Hide story and backpack tags.
Settings.use_fellowship_hint: Enable the shared Fellowship actor, fellowship themes, and relationship tags. Disable it for solo play or games without a fellowship. Reload after changing.
